chunks: Aḥmad ibn ʿAbdūn informed me, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn al-Zubayr al-Qurashī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan ibn Faḍḍāl, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAjlān, who said: I heard a truthful one who speaks truthfully about Allah—meaning Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام—say:

When you bring the deceased to his grave, do not press him abruptly upon his grave; rather, place him short of his grave by two cubits or three cubits, and leave him until he prepares himself for the grave, and do not press him upon it abruptly.

Then when you place him into his grave, let the one most entitled to him be at his head, and let him uncover his cheek and place his cheek against the earth, and let him mention the Name of Allah and seek refuge from al-Shayṭān.
And let him recite Fātiḥat al-Kitāb, Qul huwa Allāhu Aḥad, the two Muʿawwidhatayn, and Āyat al-Kursī.

Then let him say whatever he knows, and make him hear his تلقين: the testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muḥammad is the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله, and let him mention to him, one by one, what he knows.

key_terms.آيَةَ الْكُرْسِيِّ: the Throne Verse recited in this burial rite
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person being brought for burial
key_terms.الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ: the two protective surahs, Sūrat al-Falaq and Sūrat al-Nās
key_terms.شَهَادَةَ: the testimony of faith recited as part of the تلقين
key_terms.فَاتِحَةَ الْكِتَابِ: Sūrat al-Fātiḥah, recited at the grave
key_terms.قَبْرِهِ: his grave, the place of burial
key_terms.يَتَأَهَّبَ: to prepare himself, here meaning to be given a pause before burial
key_terms.يَتَعَوَّذْ: to seek refuge, specifically from al-Shayṭān

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about how to bury the deceased and perform the تلقين at the grave?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the recommended manner of bringing the deceased to the grave, placing him gently, and performing the rites at burial. It includes recitation of Qur'anic passages, seeking refuge from al-Shayṭān, and giving the deceased the تلقين of the shahādah and other known teachings, reflecting the care given to the believer at the threshold of barzakh.
